sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 23 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：TSLA、MU、SPCX、FCF、GOOGL。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump threatens the "largest strike in history" against Iran: In an Axios interview, he said he is "considering an unprecedented large-scale strike and is close to making a decision" and that "Iran hasn't felt enough pain yet." This was the biggest bearish catalyst during the session. The community almost unanimously viewed it as a setup for yet another TACO—bluster followed by a climbdown—but as of this writing, no reversal post had emerged.
  • House passes resolution limiting the president's Iran war powers, 214-208: Four Republicans broke ranks, but it is a concurrent resolution, meaning it is not legally binding and will not be sent to the president for signature. The Senate will vote separately later. The community broadly dismissed it as "symbolic and useless," noting that Trump can simply ignore it.
  • Houthis attack two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea, sending oil prices surging: Brent broke above $100 to a seven-week high, while USO reached 140.29 (+6.52%), XOM 157.58 (+2.0%), OXY 58.09 (+1.0%), and defense contractor LMT soared to 569.24 (+10.61%). Threats to a second critical shipping route compounded supply concerns.
  • Interest-rate and inflation alarms: The 10Y yield rose to approximately 4.70%, while the 30Y touched 5.18%, its highest level since 2006. Rising oil prices reignited inflation expectations, and CME data showed the probability of a September rate hike surging to approximately 82%, weighing on TLT at 83.18.
  • GOOGL extends its post-earnings plunge: It currently stands at 320.98 (-6.16%), after hitting an intraday low of 314.96. The stock broke below its 200-day moving average and set a record for the largest single-day dollar market-cap loss, as the market focused on the capex surge and negative FCF rather than EPS. TSLA is currently at 324.34 (-13.32%), marking its worst earnings-day performance since 2013 and putting it close to falling out of the $1 trillion market-cap club.
  • Semiconductors/memory show exceptional strength against the broader trend: MU broke through the 1000 threshold to 1003.38 (+4.60%), while SNDK reached 1684 (+5.28%) and NBIS 222 (+2.12%), all firmly green and forming the only oasis in a sea of red.
  • Intraday performance: SPY plunged as low as 735.25 in early trading, but at approximately 12:33 p.m. ET had recovered to 739.27 (-1.10%), reclaiming most of its losses while still battling near the opening price. QQQ was relatively weaker at 694 (-1.57%), while DIA at -0.86% and IWM at -0.73% were more resilient. SPCX unexpectedly turned positive at 115.85 (+0.51%), which the community attributed to speculation surrounding tonight's Starship test flight.

社区氛围：整体基调非常混乱、疲惫、悲观。地缘政治、油价、利率和盈利带来了四方面的负面催化剂。多头在多次被“假V”困住后变得麻木，而空头终于享受到难得的平反时刻，但同样害怕一个TACO帖子可能会立即扭转市场。整个社区一直在“逢低买入”和“亏损承担”之间摇摆。

恐惧/贪婪：恐惧，但并未失控。评论者反复质疑为什么“当我的投资组合已经第四次回撤时，恐惧指数仅为 39”，而许多人则主动转向现金、HYSA 或债券。 VIX 盘中飙升至 20 上方，这被解读为“有人提前知道”昨天尾盘不寻常走势的证据。

情绪与现实：社区感觉好像“世界末日已经到来，崩盘即将来临”，但大盘实际上仅比 ATH 低约 3%，而 SPY 已经从盘中低点大幅反弹。这种脱节——感觉就像熊市，但只比历史高点低几个百分点——本身就成了一个主要话题：“制造一个仅比 ATH 低 2% 的熊市感觉很奇怪。”
sections.stocks:
5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及频率牛/熊情绪核心观点总结
GOOGLVery High中性至看涨（高度分化）下跌-6%，跌破200日均线，创下单日市值跌幅纪录。空头指出明年自由现金流为负、资本支出失控、搜索市场份额下降以及欧盟罚款，他们认为每股收益被股权投资收益扭曲，实际上是一个失误，下行目标为 250。多头称 15 的市盈率是一代人的买入机会，并在 315/320/340c 积极累积 1 月份的股价，押注将反弹至 340。“它需要达到 400这样我就可以支付租金/收支平衡”成为了一个梗。
TSLAVery High强烈看跌下跌-13%，创下自2013年以来最糟糕的盈利日，并接近跌出1万亿美元俱乐部。 300 的市盈率仍然被认为是荒谬的，目标是 220/190。一些人在 319 点首次逢低买入，押注超卖反弹。幸灾乐祸主导了情绪。
SPCXHigh看跌（对反趋势走势感到困惑）其逆势进入积极领域令整个社区感到困惑，这归因于围绕今晚星舰试飞的猜测以及机构 1 万亿美元的沉没成本。看空者正在等待第一次解锁驱动的抛售，目标是低于 80/低于 100：“财务状况比 TSLA 更糟糕，但更贵。”
MUHigh看涨第15次突破1000点成为一个方向信号。它受益于资本支出，是少数支撑纳斯达克指数的股票之一。目标包括 1100/1250/1500，尽管有些人买入看跌期权并希望进行股票分割。
SNDKMedium强烈看涨其+5%的涨幅和完全拒绝参与抛售被视为触底信号——“红海中唯一的绿洲”。要求3K。
AMZNMedium看跌下降-4%，受到 GOOGL 资本支出担忧的影响。少数人仍然看好其较低的市值、云业务和芯片，但担心下周财报公布后自由现金流将被削减。
METAMedium看跌跌破 600：“扎克自曝了。”担忧集中在下周的盈利以及 META 可能被迫随之增加资本支出的可能性。
